mentions.name: RapidCAM
mentions.description: CAM web app for CNC work that already supports 2.5D CNC, laser, and rotary axis toolpaths, and is adding tufting support for CNC tufting makers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding tufting support to RapidCAM.app for CNC run makers.   RapidCAM already supports 2.5D CNC, laser and rotary axis so tufting was a good fit.
mentions.author: Jemm

mentions.name: RapidCAM
mentions.description: RapidCAM is a free, browser-based CNC and laser CAD/CAM app that works entirely client-side with no login required. It supports both quick designs and full 2.5D parametric models, uses an open-source file format designed for LLMs and source control, and includes a built-in visual diff system.
mentions.problem: Available CNC and laser CAD/CAM options didn't meet the author's needs, so he designed RapidCAM for himself.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://rapidcam.app    CNC and laser CAD/CAM for both quick designs and full 2.5D parametric models.   Free and runs entirely client side in the browser with no log in required.
mentions.author: Jemm
